narrative.overview: The user's visual commitment is clean, iOS-inspired black and white. The shipped interface applies that restraint through grouped white forms, quiet gray surroundings and black actions, using Windows Tk/ttk controls and Segoe UI. It remains a desktop utility with native keyboard behavior and file dialogs.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome hierarchy with plain, readable labels.
Compact header and grouped filters above a flexible results table.
Persistent space for the save actions, progress and status.
Direct state changes without decorative animation.

rules.name: The Monochrome Rule
rules.body: Preserve the user's black-and-white direction; use text and explicit selection markers to communicate state.

dos: Do preserve the compact 22pt title and reserved bottom action region.
Do keep searchable dropdowns, visible labels and exact-variant guidance together.
Do retain readable monochrome selection, disabled and empty states.
Do preserve Windows keyboard behavior and native file dialogs.
donts: Don't introduce colored accents or a phone-shaped app shell.
Don't replace actual Tk geometry with invented rounded cards or shadows.
Don't let an expanding results table push Save, Open, progress or status out of view.
Don't describe the curated Top 20 collections as official or verified popularity rankings.
